newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices lifted by Polish demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices lifted by Polish demand.

text.p: Strong demand from buyers for Poland pushed Bangladesh tea prices higher at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
They said buyers for Poland operated "very actively at mush higher prices." There was, however, subdued demand from Pakistani and Afghanistan buyers at the auction.
Some 759,419 kg of teas were sold at the auction.
The average price was 53.66 taka per kg, 1.49 taka up from previous sale.
The next auction will be held on February 4 with an expected offer of 950,000 kg. ($1 = 42.45 taka)
